args.code: the worked notebook's definitions and reference solutions, run in-process

budget.colleague: the ex7-stub featurizer: the same bumps, not scaled
budget.features: rbf_features: 625 Gaussian bumps (5^4 grid, width 0.5), unit length

note: Linear semi-gradient Q-learning on CartPole-v1 from the worked notebook (Exercise 6's train_linear_q, greedy_return and random_return with the reference linear_q_update and rbf_features), at the lab's live budget, seeds 0-19. Every per_seed list is indexed like `seeds`. recent_return[i][j] and w_norm[i][j]: the mean return of the last 10 finished episodes and ‖W‖ after budget['grid'][j] steps. greedy_return and random_return: means over the lab's 10 evaluation episodes (reset seeds seed + 10000 + k). q_start: Q(s0, ·) at reset(seed). seconds: the wall-clock of each seed's training run with rbf_features (a laptop time). colleague: the same seed trained with the ex7-stub featurizer (unfixed); null marks a non-finite ‖W‖ or Q. Wall time for the 40 training runs and their evaluations on local (Apple M1 Pro, arm64): a laptop time, not a Colab time. One-minute load average 6.6 at the start and 5.8 at the end (other builds were running on this machine).
